description: Land Settlement Department - Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District   - Cad. Map No. 420500
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on property ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
